description:
CDISC validation rule engine: rule-package loader, check evaluator,
        report assembler and the pluggable report-writer SPI. Ships NO report
        writer of its own - json/json-2 and xlsx live in cumba-oss-cdisc-report-json
        and cumba-oss-cdisc-report-xlsx - so the engine carries no Excel dependency.
        Ships the dataviewer's net.cumba.cdisc.core.* source verbatim.
